subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this protected Signal PR require redacted after-fix receive-path proof, or is the focused regression coverage and hosted gate sufficient for an explicit exception?
rationale: The patch changes message-delivery semantics and the contributor states that no linked Signal account was available, so only a responsible owner can accept or waive the real-behavior gate.

options.title: Require live Signal proof
options.body: Request a redacted transcript, bridge log, or terminal capture showing two debounced inbound messages arrive at the agent with real line breaks.

options.title: Grant a proof exception
options.body: Accept the focused regression test and exact-head hosted CI as sufficient for this narrowly scoped fix despite no linked Signal account.

recommendation.title: Require live Signal proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted transcript, bridge log, or terminal capture showing two debounced inbound messages arrive at the agent with real line breaks.

likelyOwner.reason: The author is assigned to this active Signal change and can either supply the available evidence or route the exception to the relevant owner.
